Why enable this: this is required so Tiny Vow can know how long the target app was used today.\n\nHow to enable: tap the button below -> find Tiny Vow in the system list -> enable usage access.

This stage does not add system-level hard blocking or sync. It focuses on permission checks, target app selection, today usage reading, daily limit storage, and over-limit reminders.

Why enable this: when a target app exceeds its limit in the foreground, this service can show a full-screen floating page to stop continued use.\n\nHow to enable: tap the button below -> find Tiny Vow Soft Blocking Service in the system accessibility service list -> enable the service.

Purpose: some phone vendors restrict background work, which may affect reminder and blocking reliability.\n\nNote: this is optional. Core features still work without it. After tapping the button, look for Auto-start or Allow background activity in system app details.

Some phone vendors restrict background work. Background start is an optional reliability setting that reduces the chance that timers, reminders, or blocking services are cleared by the system. You can skip it and keep the core features.

The battery allowlist is an optional reliability setting. It reduces the chance that reminders and background stats are delayed after system sleep. Tiny Vow still works if you deny or skip it, but some reminders may be less timely.

Tiny Vow reads local app usage data, including package names, app names, foreground usage time, launch counts, sessions, and night usage statistics. This powers daily limits, reports, points, and reminders. By default, the data stays on this device and is not uploaded automatically.

Tiny Vow\'s accessibility service only listens for window changes. It checks whether you entered an app with a configured limit and shows Tiny Vow\'s blocking page when the limit is exceeded. It does not read screen text, click on your behalf, or change system settings.

Tiny Vow uses notification permission to send local limit reminders and over-limit alerts, so you can see your daily budget status in time. Denying notifications does not affect core features such as groups, stats, or blocking.
